description:
Send batch emails.

Sends up to 100 emails in one call. All-or-nothing, if any email is invalid none are sent. Attachments, `scheduled_at` and a per-email `tenant_id` are supported; the paused-tenant and tenant-cap errors apply to the whole batch.

Put the emails in `body` as an array. Prefer send_email for a single message.

Works with a `sending_access` or `full_access` API key. API: `POST /emails/batch` (operationId `sendBatchEmails`, Emails).

items.description: Either `html` or `text` is required. `reply_to` is also accepted as `replyTo` and `scheduled_at` as `scheduledAt`.

path.description: A public URL fetched at send time.

oneOf.description: An email address, optionally with a display name: `Acme <hello@acme.com>`. At most 998 characters, display name included. A display name can't contain `<`, `>` or an encoded word, and a `from` name can only show an email address on one of your verified domains.
